integrity: Proof via natural arrangement-link realization, relative chamber exact sequence and explicit dihedral fixed orientation counts; exact finite checks for n=3 through 12 are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Determines integral top homology as a dihedral lattice and element-fixed homotopy, but only rational homology of the full symmetry quotient; arbitrary subgroup fixed loci and integral quotient homology are not classified. Possible equivalent older equivariant literature is not excluded.
title: Dihedral fixed loci and integral orientation modules of cycle coloring complexes
